title: Conditional κ = 7.51154847341386e-4: 1,738 kernel entries, 90-gate second descent, restorations and sinks re-derived fresh on #275's weighted gen5b word
body:
Conditional κ = `375577423670693/(5·10^17)` = **7.51154847341386e-4**, +1.43 × 10⁻⁸ (+0.0019 %) over [#305](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/305) (7.51140529238897e-4), +0.0105 % over [#275](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/275) (7.51075693834608e-4). The bit side binds below #233's complex supplier.

One self-contained package, `research/gen5bw-full/` (#305's package with its selections re-derived), with its own workflow; branched from `main`, no existing file changed.

**Full replay: PASS** on the committed package: all twelve stages fresh (virtual, raw, bit with descent and targets, kernel, second descent, restore, sink, scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite), package integrity unchanged (167 files), `PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_RESTORE_SINK_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION`, κ `375577423670693/500000000000000000`, ~7 minutes. Note: [#306](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/306) (chafreaky, reorder stage on #305) is above this PR; the composition of that stage with these fresh selections follows as a separate PR.

## Change

#305 translated #300's 1,734 kernel entries and 87 second-descent gates onto George Lydakis' weighted gen5b word by logical helper roles. Here every selection is **re-derived on the weighted word itself** by the same discovery scripts (`discovery/coll/load.py` → `families.py` → `pack_restarts.py` → `build_selection.py`; `descent4g`; `build_restore_selection.py`; `build_sink_selection.py`), with a longer randomized packing search:

| stage | #305 (translated from #300) | this package (fresh on the weighted word) |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| collective kernel entries (450 restarts, seed 21) | 1,734, rank 2,196, φ −3,860 | **1,738** (920 pairs, 427 triples, 391 quadruples), rank **2,200**, φ **−3,880.5** |
| second constructed-frame descent | 87 gates | **90 gates** (delta {1: +39, 2: +153, 3: −81, 4: −51, 5: +27, 7: −48, 9: +24, 12: −24, 14: +24, 18: −39, 19: +39}) |
| early restorations | 440 | 440 |
| terminal sinks | 8 (R 15,424) | 8 (R 15,424) |

The twin/collective census of the weighted word is identical to gen5b's (952 pairs, 2,104 triples, 3,807 quadruples; plain greedy φ −3,799, 1,720 entries), so the gain is the packing search plus the descent run on the actual kernel word. Transforms, checkers, pins plumbing, bank tiling, #275's weighted virtual word and producer are unchanged from #305; `expected/kernel-pins.json` and `MANIFEST.json` regenerated (167 files). Every changed count is a recomputed pin; none dropped.

## Verify

```bash
python3 -m pip install -r research/gen5bw-full/requirements.txt
```
```bash
python3 -B research/gen5bw-full/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5bw-full-verification
```

Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, new output directory outside the package; about 7 minutes; prints `PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_RESTORE_SINK_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION` with the pinned κ.

## Scope and credits

Exactly #275/#305's hypotheses and conditional interfaces; no Lean build. George Lydakis (#275: weighted gen5b matching and package), eumemic (#305: the composition this re-derives), chafreaky (#296 gen5b, #295/#299 stages, kernel discovery), DreamingOfClouds, Dugongue, utcorvusvolat-dotcom, hcg890, Jacob Sussman, Evan McKinney and the retained lineage; the second descent and restart packing are from #291/#300. Prepared by Rohan Arun with Anthropic Claude assistance; Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`.
